```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
source("code/R/visualization.R")
source("code/R/statistics.R")
```

```{r}
palette_df <- read.csv("metadata/clean/project_palette.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
palette <- setNames(palette_df$color, palette_df$label)
```

```{r}
mdata_prospective_path = "metadata/clean/metadata_prospective.csv"
mdata_prospective = read.csv(mdata_prospective_path, header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(mdata_prospective) = mdata_prospective %>% colnames() %>% tolower() %>% gsub("_[0-9].*|_laura","",.)
mdata_prospective <- mdata_prospective %>% mutate(surgery_type = "No surgery", 
                                                  n_polyps = NA,
                                                  phenotype = ifelse(is_fatty_liver, "Fatty Liver", "Control"),
                                                  cohort = "Prospective Cohort")
```

```{r}
mdata_fap_path = "metadata/clean/metadata_fap.csv"
mdata_fap = read.csv(mdata_fap_path, header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(mdata_fap) = mdata_fap %>% colnames() %>% tolower() %>% gsub("_[0-9].*","",.)
mdata_fap <- mdata_fap %>% mutate(colonoscopy_classification = 5,
                                  cohort = "FAP Cohort",
                                  phenotype = ifelse(phenotype == 1, "Classical FAP", "Non-classical FAP"),
                                  surgery_type = case_when(surgery_type == 1 ~ "Pouch",
                                                           surgery_type == 2 ~ "Subtotal colectomy",
                                                           TRUE ~ "No surgery"))
```

```{r}
colono_groups_path <- "metadata/clean/sample_summary.csv"
colono_groups <- read.csv(colono_groups_path, header = TRUE,
                          sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)# %>% select(-n)
```

```{r}
shared_cols = intersect(colnames(mdata_fap), colnames(mdata_prospective))
mdata = rbind(mdata_prospective[shared_cols], mdata_fap[shared_cols]) %>% 
        left_join(colono_groups, by = c("colonoscopy_classification" = "group_id")) %>% 
        mutate(gender = ifelse(gender == 0, "Female", "Male"),
               case_number = as.character(case_number),
               patient_id = paste(track_number, cohort, sep = "_"))
```

```{r}
mdata <- mdata %>% select(patient_id, case_number, sigma_id) %>% 
          tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -patient_id, names_to = "sample_source", values_to = "sample_id") %>%
          left_join(mdata %>% select(-case_number, -sigma_id), by = "patient_id") %>% 
          mutate(batch = ifelse(sample_source == "sigma_id", "Batch 22", "Batch 24"),
                 is_surgery = surgery_type != "No surgery")

mdata <- mdata %>% filter(!sample_id %in% c(0, "35808028", NA)) # sample_id 0 is for samples without a case number, 35808028 is a duplicate case number for two patients (prospective cohort)
```


# Add specific columns from the FAP metadata
```{r}
cols_to_add <- c("number_of_polyps_colonoindex_date")
mdata_to_add <- mdata_fap %>% mutate(patient_id = paste0(track_number, "_FAP Cohort")) %>% select(patient_id, all_of(cols_to_add))
mdata <- mdata %>% left_join(mdata_to_add, by = "patient_id") %>% rename(n_polyps = number_of_polyps_colonoindex_date)
```

## Compare key metadata features between groups
```{r}
target_samples <- read.csv("qiime/combined/6_Taxonomy_GTDB/feature_table.tsv",sep = "\t", check.names = F) %>% 
                  select(-taxon) %>% colnames()
batch_24_specific <- c("35919746","35956773" ) # patients 4 and 7
```

```{r}
df <- mdata %>% filter(sample_id %in% c(target_samples,batch_24_specific)) %>%
      select(patient_id, age, gender, phenotype, surgery_type, 
             bmi,is_current_smoker, is_ever_smoker, n_polyps, med_diet_sum) %>% unique() %>% 
                 filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver") %>% 
                 mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = c("Classical FAP","Non-classical FAP","Control")),
                        smoking = case_when(is_ever_smoker == 0 ~ "Non-smoker",
                                            is_current_smoker == 0 ~ "Former smoker",
                                           TRUE ~ "Current smoker"), 
                         is_ever_smoker = ifelse( is_ever_smoker == 0, "Non-smoker","Smoker"),
                        is_surgery = ifelse(surgery_type == "No surgery", "No surgery", "Surgery"))
df %>% sample_n(10)
```

```{r}
max_age <- max(df$age) # used to increase the y limit and leave space for significance start
min_age <- min(df$age)
max_bmi <- max(df$bmi) # used to increase the y limit and leave space for significance start
min_bmi <- min(df$age)
p_age <- ggplot(df, aes(phenotype, age, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + plot_box_and_jitter(palette = palette) + labs(y = "Age", x ="") + 
  ylim(min_age*0.95, max_age*1.1)
p_bmi <- ggplot(df, aes(phenotype, bmi, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + plot_box_and_jitter(palette = palette) + labs(y = "BMI", x = "") + 
  ylim(min_bmi*0.95, max_bmi*1.1)
```

```{r}
ggdata <- df %>% count(phenotype, is_ever_smoker) %>% group_by(phenotype) %>% mutate(perc = n/sum(n))

p_smoking <- ggplot(ggdata, aes(x = phenotype, y = perc, fill = is_ever_smoker, label = n)) +  
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity",colour="black",) +
  geom_text(position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(c( "#f2f2f2", "#7f7f7f"))) + 
  labs(y = "Proportion", fill = "Smoking status", x = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "top")
```


```{r}
ggdata <- df %>% count(phenotype, gender) %>% group_by(phenotype) %>% mutate(perc = n/sum(n))

p_gender <- ggplot(ggdata, aes(x = phenotype, y = perc, fill = gender, label = n)) +  
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity",colour="black",) +
  geom_text(position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(c( "#f2f2f2", "#7f7f7f"))) + 
  labs(y = "Proportion", fill = "Gender", x = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
ggdata <- df %>% filter(phenotype != "Control")
p_polyps <- ggplot(ggdata, aes(x = phenotype, y = n_polyps, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + 
   plot_box_and_jitter(palette = palette) + 
  labs(y = "Number of polyps", x = "")
```

```{r}
ggdata <- df %>% filter(phenotype != "Control") %>% count(phenotype, is_surgery) %>% group_by(phenotype) %>% mutate(perc = n/sum(n)) #%>%
          # mutate(surgery_type = factor(surgery_type,
          #                              levels = rev(c("No surgery", "Subtotal colectomy", "Pouch"))))

p_surgery <- ggplot(ggdata, aes(x = phenotype, y = perc, fill = is_surgery, label = n)) +  
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity",colour="black",) +
  geom_text(position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = rev(c( "#f2f2f2","#cccccc", "#7f7f7f"))) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(c( "#f2f2f2", "#7f7f7f"))) + 
  labs(y = "Proportion", fill = "Surgery", x = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
library(patchwork)
s1 = (p_age + p_bmi)/(p_polyps + p_gender)/(p_smoking + p_surgery) + 
      patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')
plot(s1)
ggsave("figures/S1_metadata.svg", s1, width = 21, height = 21.3, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
wilcox_tests <- rbind(wilcox_test_by_pair(df, "phenotype", "age ~ phenotype", FALSE) %>% mutate(category = "age"),
                      wilcox_test_by_pair(df, "phenotype", "bmi ~ phenotype", FALSE) %>% mutate(category = "bmi"),
                      wilcox_test_by_pair(df %>% filter(phenotype != "Control"), "phenotype", "n_polyps ~ phenotype", FALSE) %>% mutate(category = "n_polyps"))
wilcox_tests %>% add_significance()
```
```{r}
chi_sq_tests <- c((df %>% select(phenotype, is_current_smoker) %>% table() %>% chisq.test())$p.value,
                  (df %>% select(phenotype, gender) %>% table() %>% chisq.test())$p.value,
                  (df %>% filter(phenotype != "Control") %>% mutate(phenotype = as.character(phenotype)) %>% 
          select(phenotype, is_surgery)  %>% table() %>% chisq.test())$p.value) %>% as.numeric()
chi_sq_tests <- data.frame(p_value = chi_sq_tests, category = c("smoking", "gender", "surgery")) %>% mutate(group1 = "multi group comparison", group2 = NA)
```


```{r}
statistics_results <- rbind(wilcox_tests, chi_sq_tests)  %>% add_significance()
statistics_results
```
